name: Rocky Mountain Rangelands Program
summary: Grants for voluntary habitat work in the Intermountain West: sagebrush rangeland restoration, secure ungulate migration corridors, and wetland bird and native fish habitat.

geography.label: Intermountain West (Idaho, Utah and neighbouring states)

reporting: Grantees report on project metrics chosen from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system.

status.quote: Rocky Mountain Rangelands 2025 Request for Proposals - CLOSED

deadline.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Thursday August 7, 2025, 11:59 PM ET

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, U.S. Federal government agencies, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal governments, educational institutions.

geography.quote: NFWF will consider projects in Idaho that apply integrated, ecologically-based invasive plant management strategies

access.quote: All application materials must be submitted online through National Fish and Wildlife Foundation's Easygrants system.

reporting.quote: the Rocky Mountain Rangelands Program has a list of metrics in Easygrants for full proposal applicants to choose from for future reporting
